evidence: developer tree 0 CRLF / 229 LF vs worktree 223 CRLF / 0 LF
within one test a newline-tolerant pattern passed while a bare-newline pattern failed on the same file
headlineFinding.fix: reconstruction worktrees check out with core.autocrlf=false

runtimeArbitration.question: Does the asserted text still exist, or did the contract change?
runtimeArbitration.method: Byte-level line-ending comparison between the developer tree and a worktree checkout, then a controlled re-checkout with core.autocrlf=false, then a full dashboard re-run.
runtimeArbitration.result: Text unchanged. The worktree wrote CRLF; the bare-newline pattern could not match. With autocrlf disabled the file has 0 CRLF and all 10 predicted tests pass.
